content: The Wdg module shall not implement an interface for de - initialization/shutdown. If th e watchdog supports a de - initialization/shutdown and the environment allows the usage of this feature, the de - initialization/shutdown shall be achieved by calling the Wdg_SetMode routine with OFF mode parameter.
